name: tailscale-mcp
description: Drive a Tailscale node and its tailnet through the CLI and the control-plane API
long_description:
Reads and drives the Tailscale node this bundle runs on through the `tailscale` command-line interface, and the tailnet behind it through the control-plane REST API. The local tools need the `tailscale` command-line interface installed; the tailnet tools need a control-plane credential. Whichever backend is missing, its tools are not offered rather than failing when called.

Tools are read-only unless you permit more. Write tools change configuration; destructive tools remove or expose something, such as deleting a device or publishing a funnel. Each tier is hidden until it is permitted, so a tool that is not offered cannot be called by mistake.

api_key.title: API access token
api_key.description: A control-plane API access token, from the Tailscale admin console. Leave it empty to use an OAuth client instead, or to offer only the tools that drive this node.

oauth_client_id.title: OAuth client ID
oauth_client_id.description: An OAuth client ID, used with its secret when there is no API access token. An OAuth client is the better choice for long-lived use: it is scoped, and its tokens are short-lived.

oauth_client_secret.title: OAuth client secret
oauth_client_secret.description: The secret that goes with the OAuth client ID.

tailnet.title: Tailnet
tailnet.description: The tailnet the control-plane tools act on. Leave it empty to act on the one the credential belongs to.

preset.title: Tools to offer
preset.description: Which group of tools to offer: minimal, core or full.

allow_write.title: Permit changes
allow_write.description: Offer the tools that change configuration, such as bringing the node up or tagging a device. Read-only without this.

allow_destructive.title: Permit removal and exposure
allow_destructive.description: Offer the tools that remove or expose something, such as deleting a device or publishing a service to the internet. Implies the previous setting.

cli_path.title: Tailscale command
cli_path.description: Where the `tailscale` binary is, when it is not on the path. Leave it empty to look for it in the usual places.
